summary: Public tests of AI-text detectors, including OpenAI's classifier, showed they mislabeled human writing such as Macbeth as likely AI-generated and missed much AI text. Observers worried students could be wrongly penalized.
technical_summary: A GPT model fine-tuned as a binary classifier to separate human from AI text, released publicly. Limited training data and low accuracy (about 26% detection) produced false positives on human and old texts and false negatives on AI text.

notes: Mostly potential harm; no specific wrongful penalty described in excerpts.

summary: Reports say the Israeli military used AI systems called Lavender and The Gospel to generate targets in Gaza, with humans reportedly giving only brief approval. Sources allege the systems contributed to strikes with many civilian deaths.
technical_summary: Lavender is a machine-learning system that scores people in Gaza on likelihood of militant affiliation using mass surveillance data, producing target lists; The Gospel targets buildings. Known misidentification and minimal human review reportedly led to strikes on wrongly flagged people.

summary: A Russian-aligned campaign called Operation Overload reportedly used AI-generated voices and logos to impersonate over 80 media, academic and police organizations in false videos. Most posts got little attention, but one false USAID video drew millions of views.
technical_summary: Operation Overload pairs real footage with AI voice cloning and spoofed branding to create fake news clips, amplified by bot networks across X, Telegram and Bluesky. The mechanism is deliberate use of synthetic audio for impersonation and disinformation.

summary: A developer let a Claude Code agent run Terraform commands, and it destroyed the production infrastructure and database snapshots of a course platform. AWS support helped restore the data after about a day.
technical_summary: A coding agent executing Terraform without the correct state file created duplicate resources, then, once an old state file was supplied, ran a destroy that removed the VPC, database and snapshots. Auto-approved commands and missing safeguards enabled the deletion.

failure_mode.quote: I was overly reliant on my Claude Code agent
A Terraform auto-approve command inadvertently wiped out all production infrastructure

harm_type.quote: all automated snapshots were deleted too

severity.quote: Thankfully, they helped me restore the database, and the full recovery took about 24 hours.

notes: Operator error and agent action jointly responsible.

technical_summary: Law-enforcement license-plate reader cameras and a state crime database were accessed for non-law-enforcement purposes. Weak access controls and misuse by an insider enabled covert tracking of an individual's movements.

technical_summary: Facebook's ad delivery and interest-categorization algorithms continued serving military gear ads to accounts mimicking far-right users despite a policy pause, indicating enforcement and moderation gaps.

summary: A Springer Nature machine learning book reportedly contained many citations that did not exist or were wrong, a pattern consistent with AI-generated text. Cited researchers confirmed they had not written the works attributed to them.
technical_summary: Text in the book appears to have been produced with a large language model, which generates plausible but fabricated references. Without verification before publication, nonexistent and misattributed citations reached a commercial ebook.

sector.quote: Mastering Machine Learning: From Basics to Advanced, published by Springer Nature in April.

technology.quote: Nonexistent and error-prone citations are a hallmark of text generated by large language models like ChatGPT.

failure_mode.quote: Two-thirds of them either did not exist or had substantial errors.
